title: Solving the problem of traditional academic publishing: a decentralized, Cardano-based alternative

ms.promise:

ms.report:
As detailed in our original milestone, we committed to conducting a comprehensive, cross-disciplinary literature review on decentralized academic peer-review models, adhering closely to PRISMA guidelines. We are pleased to submit our finalized, detailed thematic analysis report along with a high-quality summary video, as our Proof of Achievement for this milestone.
Outputs & Acceptance Criteria Met:
・Completed an extensive literature review and thematic analysis of 79 peer-reviewed articles, clearly identifying core themes, comparative analyses of decentralized peer review models, and theoretical and practical frameworks.
・Produced an engaging, informative video clearly summarizing our review process, highlighting key findings, and articulating the implications and potential for decentralized, blockchain-based peer review platforms built on Cardano.

Evidence of Milestone Completion:
・Complete Thematic Analysis Report: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QGUnsFSYsLWvqGDgqvn8aYG7rfjDcJFV/view?usp=sharing
・Summary Video Presentation: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E1JPSC3TXrtnPONIaTPN0I4pXSVlloN3/view?usp=sharing

Both deliverables fully meet the milestone's defined outputs and acceptance criteria. The report provides actionable insights into current challenges and potential solutions, while the video offers an accessible, engaging overview of our key findings and recommendations.
Thank you for reviewing our milestone deliverables—we look forward to your feedback and to continuing our work toward building a decentralized peer-review future with Cardano.

Outputs:
・Summarized findings report detailing insights into the current peer-review processes and potential improvements.
・SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis document evaluating the current academic publishing practices, focusing on peer-review mechanisms.

ms.report:
As part of Milestone 3, we have completed a comprehensive research phase focused on peer-review system challenges, innovations, and the viability of blockchain-based solutions—particularly within the Cardano ecosystem.
Deliverables included in this submission:
・A detailed final report titled "Towards a Better Peer Review System: Challenges, Innovations, and Blockchain Solutions", which synthesizes insights from industry analysis and in-depth interviews with academic experts. The report explores current pain points in peer review and evaluates decentralized models grounded in the Cardano ecosystem.
・A comprehensive SWOT analysis of the traditional peer review system, clearly identifying its strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats in an easy-to-reference tabular format.
・A short summary video update (approximately 12 minutes) which highlights key findings from this milestone for both general academic audiences and the Project Catalyst community.

These deliverables meet the acceptance criteria and evidence requirements outlined in our approved roadmap.
Report and video access:
・Full Report (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZoOUV7qB0gU-C3yDkZ9qloSdH3pmf0eW/view?usp=sharing
・Summary Video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LeIHzqGGTTCKdWwF-OMZ1Twsp_8Jeyle/view?usp=sharing

This submission is free of sensitive information and is suitable for public viewing.

We are pleased to submit the final Proof of Achievement for Milestone 4 of our Fund 13 proposal, “Decentralized Peer-Reviewed Publishing on Cardano.” This milestone involved synthesizing the findings from the previous three milestones, developing a roadmap for an MVP platform, and producing final open-access materials for the Cardano community.
✅ Conference Manuscripts
 We produced three academically styled manuscripts—based on original research, interviews, and analysis—intended for future submission to Cardano-focused and decentralized publishing conferences.
Note: Each manuscript is intentionally brief (~1500 words), in line with typical academic conference submission formats.
・Conference Manuscript 1 – Literature Review Outcomes
・Conference Manuscript 2 – The State of Decentralized Publishing
・Conference Manuscript 3 – Designing Decentralized Peer Review

✅ Strategic Roadmap and Supporting Documents
 We developed a 12-month implementation roadmap for a working MVP, including an overview of necessary technical phases, aligned deliverables, incentive structures, and infrastructure requirements:
・12-Month MVP Roadmap
・Functional Requirements Document

✅ Final Close-Out Report and Video
 Our final report offers a plain-language synthesis of all milestones, summarizing research outcomes and highlighting future opportunities. The companion video report helps make this work more accessible to the broader Catalyst and Cardano communities:
・Final Exit Report – Decentralized Peer-Reviewed Publishing
・Milestone 4 Video Report: https://vimeo.com/1139565149

✅ Open Access Repository
 All public-facing reports, videos, and manuscripts have been made available under Creative Commons (CC0) via our open-access GitHub repos
